Uni's uni-ball ZENTO Signature Model (UB-ZH) is the upper-grade line of the ZENTO series, built around a purpose-designed ink formula and offered in three ball-size and colour combinations.

✅ ZENTO Ink, Engineered For Reduced Friction
The newly developed ZENTO ink is a low-viscosity water-based formula. A POA-type surfactant works as a cushion between the ball tip and the paper, reducing writing friction by approximately 40 percent compared to Uni's previous water-based pens, for a notably smooth glide across the page.

✅ Pigment-Based Ink For Long-Term Records
As the ink is pigment-based rather than dye-based, lines resist fading from water and light exposure, making this pen a dependable choice for notes, records and documents intended for longer-term storage.

✅ Attraction Particles For Crisp, Clean Lines
Attraction particles within the ink draw the colourant together as it settles on paper, limiting feathering and reducing show-through on thinner paper stock, so lines stay defined and legible.

✅ Magnetic Cap, Snap-Off Design
The cap attaches to the body with a magnet and releases with a light, positive pull rather than a twist or pry motion, allowing quick one-handed capping between notes.

✅ Three Ball Sizes, Three Finishes
UB-ZH-07 writes at 0.7mm in Champagne Gold, UB-ZH-38 at 0.38mm in Silver, and UB-ZH-05 at 0.5mm in Metallic Black, giving a line-width option suited to everyday notes, fine detail work or signatures alike.

Specifications:
🔸 Country of Origin: Japan
🔸 Key Materials: Painted aluminium cap, brass and ABS resin front barrel, painted ABS resin rear barrel, pigment-based ZENTO water-based ink
🔸 Brand: Uni
🔸 Model: UB-ZH-07 / UB-ZH-38 / UB-ZH-05
🔸 Ink Colour: Black only
🔸 Size: Approx. length 122.6mm / diameter 13.2mm / thickness 17.2mm / weight 22.9g
🔸 JAN: 4902778351406 (UB-ZH-07) / 4902778322291 (UB-ZH-38) / 4902778322307 (UB-ZH-05)
🔸 Variants: 0.7mm Champagne Gold / 0.38mm Silver / 0.5mm Metallic Black
🔸 Packaging: Paper box packaging

How to Use:
① Pull the cap directly away from the body to release the magnetic catch.
② Write as usual, allowing the ZENTO ink to lay down a smooth, even line.
③ Push the cap back onto the body until the magnet catches securely.
④ Store the pen horizontally or upright with the cap closed when not in use.

FAQ:
Q: Does the ink colour differ by variant?
A: No, all three write in black ink only, each using the UB-ZH refill matched to its ball size.
